title: Compare food by time, labor and access
applies_when: Food reserves or future supply need attention.
approach: Distinguish edible supplies now from harvest, hunting, fishing and cultivation potential.
Compare time to food, available labor, route risk, season and terrain. Combine near-term supply with longer-term production when justified.
Select crops from native harvested products, fertility requirements and growth data; decorative plants are not interchangeable with food crops.
verify: Nearby allowed supplies and actual nutrition, not only map-wide potential.
Crop definitions, eligible terrain, growing conditions, animal risk and native fishing availability.
reconsider: Season, available labor or accessible food sources change.
A proposed method is unavailable or unsafe; choose another supported option.
